### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. hearing loss, autosomal dominant 73  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.719)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9679)

**Proposed mechanism:** PTPRQ (HGNC:9679) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155); Regulation of cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Deafness, congenital, conductive (HP:0000418); Regulation of cell adhesion and migration (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment, progressive (HP:0000378). Loss-of-function mutations in PTPRQ disrupt its function in regulating cell adhesion and migration, which are critical processes for the development and maintenance of the auditory system. This disruption leads to conductive hearing loss in MONDO:0013249 and progressive hearing impairment in hearing loss, autosomal dominant 73 (MONDO:0033260).

**How to falsify it:** Identifying distinct, non-overlapping molecular pathways downstream of PTPRQ that are exclusively affected in either MONDO:0013249 or hearing loss, autosomal dominant 73, respectively, would falsify the hypothesis of a shared mechanistic link. _(variant: Exome sequencing data from gnomAD showing a high frequency (>1%) of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in PTPRQ in the general population would also challenge this hypothesis.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of PTPRQ in auditory function could lead to the development of novel therapeutic strategies targeting common pathways for both conditions, potentially improving hearing outcomes for patients with either disease.
